turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Of course. Quick rule: "a" before consonant sounds (a dog), "an" before vowel sounds (an apple), and "the" when the listener knows which thing (I saw a dog. The dog was big.).

Here is your first one: Write a or an: My uncle is ___ doctor. Write just the missing word.
